messages:
ops-bot: [ALERT] realtime p99 latency regression detected for hosted-api-prod (p99 6.8s, p95 1.2s -> 2.1s). Query: https://dash.redwood.internal/hosted-api/p99?window=5m
ops-bot: Alert triggered by realtime-detector v3.4 — rule: p99 > 5s for 3m :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: Paging on-call: @kai (oncall)
kai: on it. grabbing context. anyone seeing errors from customers?
alexa: support: multiple customers reporting failed streaming responses and 'request timed out' in last 10m. raising customer-impact flag.
mira: checking dashboards — eu-west1 and us-central show p99 spikes. streaming tail latency looks noisy. KV cache miss rate up ~4x in eu-west1.
devon: pushed quantized-model-v2 at 02:12 UTC to hosted-prod canary ~2 hours ago. rollout shows ~60% traffic now.
samir: ok quick triage plan: 1) confirm impact 2) mitigate (rollback or route) 3) collect traces/logs 4) update pagerduty
kai: yep. mira can you pull traces for a few sample request ids? also echo the rollout command
mira: traces show long stalls inside token-generation loop, threads stuck >200ms waiting on kernel. sample req: req_4409_12
mira:
```logs
[2026-03-15T10:01:12Z] req_4409_12 model:quantized-v2 step:gen token_delay=230ms kernel_wait=180ms
[2026-03-15T10:01:13Z] req_4409_19 model:quantized-v2 token_delay=310ms kernel_wait=260ms
```
devon: looking at runtime metrics—GPU queue length spiked, but CPU side also experiencing blocking. suspect new kernel selection path for quantized-v2.
samir: mitigation options: - immediate rollback to model-v1 - divert traffic to v1 for streaming endpoints - bump dedicated pool scale (costly)
kai: do we have a quick routing knob? canary rollback faster than scaling.
devon: yes. command:
```bash
# roll back canary
rctl rollout cancel --service hosted-api --model quantized-v2
rctl route set --service hosted-api --model model-v1 --percentage 100
```
kai: I'll do a safe partial diversion first: route 30%->model-v1 for streaming. devon, mira, monitor.
kai: @devon please stand by to cancel rollout if diversion doesn't move p99 within 3m
devon: executing now
devon:
```bash
rctl route set --service hosted-api --model model-v1 --percentage 30 --endpoint /v1/stream
```
ops-bot: action logged: route-change by devon at 4409990015
mira: dashboard after diversion: p99 decreased from 6.8s -> 3.4s in eu-west1 (2m after), p95 steady. tail stalls reduced in sample traces.
alexa: starting customer comms draft to impacted customers, will update after stabilization. :email:
kai: good. continuing with staged rollback to 60% if metrics keep improving. devon, once 60% stable, we can schedule full rollback.
devon: increased to 60%... command complete.
devon: perf after 60%: p99 2.0s in eu-west1, p95 back to baseline ~1.1s. streaming errors reduced by ~70%.
kai: marking as mitigated for now. paging: Inform oncall rotation and create incident ticket.
pagerduty-bot: Incident #INC-440999 acknowledged. Oncall: kai -> handing to mira for postmortem. Escalate to eng-runtime if rollback full required.
mira: taking ownership for incident investigation and follow-up. will collect config diffs, kernel selection logs, and rollout timeline.
kai: thanks. devon, please open a runtime-issue and ping eng-runtime oncall for kernel selector review.
devon: opened RN-4409 and pinged @eng-runtime-oncall. attaching logs.
samir: quick notes for incident ticket: root suspected = kernel-selection path for quantized-v2 causing scheduling stalls under certain seq-len distribution. mitigation = route/diversion then rollback.
alexa: customer comms queued, will send update with ETA for root cause and follow-up call if requested.
kai: updating PagerDuty and closing on-call handoff. monitoring for 15m before declaring resolved.
ops-bot: watch configured: p99 < 3s for 15m. notified #postmortems to expect incident doc.
mira: will start timeline and collect repro steps. assigning to devon and @eng-runtime-oncall for deep dive.
kai: thanks all. one more quick check: streaming throughput not degraded during mitigation?
devon: throughput slightly lower but within SLA after diversion. will continue to watch.
kai: closing thread for now. open follow-ups: incident writeup, kernel selector fix, rollout guard rails (traffic limits, runtime fallback). :white_check_mark:
